sqlMap.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS R WHERE R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM PRODUCTS P
SELECT T.ORDER_ID, T.TOTAL FROM (SELECT ORDER_ID, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL FROM ORDERS GROUP BY ORDER_ID) T WHERE T.TOTAL >= #minTotal#

SELECT U.USER_ID FROM USERS U
INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON U.USER_ID = O.USER_ID
WHERE U.STATUS = #status#

SELECT USER_ID FROM USERS WHERE STATUS = #status#
UNION SELECT USER_ID FROM ARCHIVED_USERS WHERE STATUS = #status#

SELECT O.ORDER_ID FROM
ARCHIVED_ORDERS O
ORDERS O
WHERE O.STATUS = #status#
